tools.name: list_today_quests
tools.title: List Today's Quests
tools.description: List active scheduled Guilduo quests visible today, including overdue work.

tools.name: list_quests
tools.title: List Quests
tools.description: List Guilduo quests by today, week, future, backlog, completed, archive, or all views.

tools.name: create_quest
tools.title: Create Quest
tools.description: Create a Guilduo habit, daily, todo, or reward with planning and priority details.

tools.name: update_quest
tools.title: Update Quest
tools.description: Edit one Guilduo quest. Moving a scheduled date later increments rolloverCount.

tools.name: batch_update_quests
tools.title: Batch Update Quests
tools.description: Preview or atomically update up to 100 quests, including postponing or moving them to backlog.

tools.name: batch_score_quests
tools.title: Batch Score Quests
tools.description: Preview or atomically complete or reopen up to 100 quests. One-off todo quests become archived when completed.

tools.name: archive_quests
tools.title: Archive Quests
tools.description: Preview or archive completed one-off todo quests. Archived quests are retained permanently.

tools.name: link_external_record
tools.title: Link External Record
tools.description: Link a Google Calendar, Toggl, or other external record to a quest.

tools.name: score_quest
tools.title: Score Quest
tools.description: Complete, reopen, or score a quest and apply its HP, XP, Gem, and MP effects. A completed one-off todo is archived automatically.

tools.name: get_character_state
tools.title: Get Character State
tools.description: Return the current character, MP, equipment, and boss state.

tools.name: buy_reward
tools.title: Buy Reward
tools.description: Redeem a reward quest using Gems.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.title: List Integrations
tools.description: List per-user integration connection, configuration, and reconnect status without exposing provider tokens.

tools.name: get_toggl_focus_status
tools.title: Get Toggl Focus Status
tools.description: Read the user's Toggl Focus connection configuration and current timer without exposing the personal API key.

tools.name: list_toggl_focus_entries
tools.title: List Toggl Focus Entries
tools.description: List up to 30 days of Toggl Focus time entries and their current Guilduo attribution state.

tools.name: sync_quest_to_toggl_focus
tools.title: Sync Quest to Toggl Focus
tools.description: Preview or create/update one active To Do or Daily as a Toggl Focus task. Tags may be created in Focus on execution.

tools.name: get_toggl_focus_tracking
tools.title: Get Toggl Focus Tracking
tools.description: Read the current Toggl Focus timer and its linked Focus task when available.

tools.name: start_toggl_focus_tracking
tools.title: Start Toggl Focus Tracking
tools.description: Preview or start a Focus timer for a linked Quest. If another timer is running, confirm its exact entry ID first.

tools.name: stop_toggl_focus_tracking
tools.title: Stop Toggl Focus Tracking
tools.description: Preview or stop the exact currently running Toggl Focus timer. The expected entry ID prevents stopping a different device's timer.

tools.name: preview_toggl_attribution
tools.title: Preview Toggl Focus Attribution
tools.description: Preview direct Focus-task time entry attribution or manual candidate attribution without changing Guilduo.

tools.name: apply_toggl_attribution
tools.title: Apply Toggl Focus Attribution
tools.description: Preview or confirm one-to-one Focus time entry attribution. A Focus entry can belong to only one Quest.

tools.name: get_toggl_estimate_insights
tools.title: Get Toggl Estimate Insights
tools.description: Suggest future Quest estimates from completed Toggl Focus-linked work. Suggestions never change Quest data automatically.

tools.name: preview_external_sync
tools.title: Preview External Sync
tools.description: Preview connected Google Calendar, Google Tasks, or Notion changes without saving them.

tools.name: sync_external_service
tools.title: Sync External Service
tools.description: Run a configured external sync. dryRun defaults to true and provider writes require explicit execution.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.title: Get My Profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's Guilduo public profile settings.

tools.name: find_profile_by_handle
tools.title: Find Profile by Handle
tools.description: Find one Guilduo public profile by an exact @handle.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.title: Update Profile
tools.description: Create or update the authenticated user's public Guilduo profile metadata. Profile images are managed by the authenticated web avatar endpoint, not embedded in MCP JSON.

tools.name: list_friends
tools.title: List Friends
tools.description: List accepted friends using minimal public profile fields.

tools.name: list_friend_requests
tools.title: List Friend Requests
tools.description: List pending incoming and outgoing friend requests.

tools.name: send_friend_request
tools.title: Send Friend Request
tools.description: Send a friend request to a stable Guilduo user ID after exact-handle lookup.

tools.name: respond_friend_request
tools.title: Respond to Friend Request
tools.description: Accept or decline a pending incoming friend request.

tools.name: remove_friend
tools.title: Remove Friend
tools.description: Remove an existing friendship for both users.

tools.name: get_party
tools.title: Get Party
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's active party and minimal member profiles.

tools.name: create_party
tools.title: Create Party
tools.description: Create a party with the authenticated user as owner. One active party per user, four members maximum.

tools.name: invite_party_member
tools.title: Invite Party Member
tools.description: Create a seven-day party invite. Only the party owner can use this tool.

tools.name: accept_party_invite
tools.title: Accept Party Invite
tools.description: Accept a party invite using its one-time token or invite ID.

tools.name: leave_party
tools.title: Leave Party
tools.description: Leave the active party. Ownership transfers to the earliest remaining member.

tools.name: remove_party_member
tools.title: Remove Party Member
tools.description: Remove a party member. Only the owner can use this tool.

tools.name: get_battle_session
tools.title: Get Battle Session
tools.description: Get the current Guilduo command battle state, available commands, and MP-generating quests.

tools.name: battle_command
tools.title: Battle Command
tools.description: Preview or execute one deterministic command battle turn. Execution requires the current turn and a unique commandId.

tools.name: get_quest
tools.title: Get One Quest
tools.description: Read one Guilduo quest by ID, including child progress.

tools.name: get_quest_tree
tools.title: Get Quest Tree
tools.description: Read the parent Quest and nested child Quests with progress summaries.

tools.name: get_daily_brief
tools.title: Get Daily Brief
tools.description: Return today's quests, character state, and an optional cached Calendar schedule.

tools.name: get_review_summary
tools.title: Get Review Summary
tools.description: Summarize completed work and activity for one day or a rolling seven-day review window.

tools.name: list_agent_handoffs
tools.title: List Agent Handoffs
tools.description: List agent-assigned Guilduo handoffs by lifecycle state.

tools.name: list_registered_agents
tools.title: List Registered Agents
tools.description: List the authenticated user's private Guilduo Agent Registry profiles.

tools.name: get_current_agent_context
tools.title: Get Current Agent Context
tools.description: Return the registered Agent profile linked to the current OAuth MCP client and its effective scopes.

tools.name: get_agent_link
tools.title: Get Agent Link
tools.description: Check whether the current OAuth MCP connection is linked to a Guilduo Agent and return safe connection metadata.

tools.name: link_agent
tools.title: Link MCP Connection to Agent
tools.description: Link or intentionally relink the current OAuth MCP connection to one of the authenticated user's active Agents.

tools.name: unlink_agent
tools.title: Unlink MCP Connection
tools.description: Remove the Agent association from the current OAuth MCP connection without deleting the Agent or revoking the OAuth client grant.

tools.name: assign_quest_to_agent
tools.title: Assign Quest to Agent
tools.description: Preview or assign one Quest to a registered Agent. Execution requires the Quest's current updatedAt value.

tools.name: transition_quest_handoff
tools.title: Transition Quest Handoff
tools.description: Preview or transition an agent-assigned Quest between none, ready, working, blocked, review_required, and accepted.

tools.name: list_activity_events
tools.title: List Activity Events
tools.description: Paginate Guilduo activity events, optionally filtering by event type.

tools.name: get_calendar_schedule
tools.title: Get Calendar Schedule
tools.description: Read the cached Google Calendar schedule for a date. Connect and sync Calendar first.

tools.name: convert_calendar_event_to_quest
tools.title: Convert Calendar Event to Quest
tools.description: Create a Guilduo quest from a cached Calendar event and optional safe task-field overrides.
